name: Futami Itsuki
source:
A second-year at Hayagamori Academy. Seeing all of his friends got a girlfriend after doing part-time job, he decides to join one too. He is honest most of the time except when it comes to romance.

In CGs his hair is sometimes black and sometimes brown.
